## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, affected suite/module and behavior after this change. Link the Issue or skill proposal.

## Sources and scope

List official sources and relevant versions. Explain compatibility or migration effects. New modules must meet `docs/contributing-skills.md` and remain independently installable.

## Verification

Record commands actually run and results. Separate unit/structural, installation, synthetic browser, real application and manual checks. List checks not performed and why.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is implemented, with no placeholder skill or invented backend integration.
- [ ] User technology choice, existing behavior and security controls are preserved.
- [ ] English and Italian overview changes are aligned where needed.
- [ ] Appropriate changelog/version updates and official sources are included.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, real sessions or generated reports are included.
- [ ] No automatic legal/accessibility/security conformity claims are made.
